fact: On Tuesday 19 May 2026 the Ministry of Finance handed equipment to the 23 communes that are provincial capitals under the PATN, made up of Starlink kits, desktop computers, photocopiers, printers, batteries, a solar panel and a monthly subscription; the mayor of Am Timan and an officer of the commune of Mongo are quoted receiving it.
title: Ministère des finances : Des kits informatiques aux communes chefs-lieux des provinces
publisher: Agence tchadienne de presse et d’édition (ATPE)
